$doc: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F12, re-cut for CC-LAUNCH-EN (English only, 2026-11-10): the App Store screenshot scenes, in listing order. Each names the flags its look depends on. scripts/store-assets-check.mjs (AT-28) fails the submission lane if any of those flags is off in the tree being submitted, if an uploaded screenshot maps to no scene, or if a scene is missing a screenshot. scripts/store-screenshots.mjs captures them with every flag at its release value (config/flags.release.json) and the launch-hidden rows hidden (src/launch_hide.rs). Files are <device>-<n>-<id>.png in fastlane/screenshots/en-US.

scenes.what: The play screen: a word has been spoken and the player is spelling it
The menu: the modes with their drawn icons
SpellDoku: a sudoku of spelled words
Spell Off: pass one device, longest chain wins
